meaning: Unique identifier of the service request.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Kept as text. No duplicates found (0 removed).
analytical_use: Distinct request count (Task 1, KPI 'Total requests'); identifier uniqueness check in validation.

meaning: Date and time the request was created.
transformation: Parsed to a date-time value (0 values failed to parse).
analytical_use: Time axis for trends, weekday/hour demand and the dashboard date filter; start point of resolution_hours.

meaning: Date and time the responding agency closed the request.
transformation: Parsed to a date-time value (0 failed). Blank means no recorded closure.
analytical_use: Closure indicator (is_closed) and end point of resolution_hours.

meaning: Acronym of the City agency responsible for the request.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Converted to UPPER CASE.
analytical_use: Agency workload, median resolution, outliers and closure rate (Tasks 3, 10, 11, 14).

meaning: Full name of the responding agency.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.
analytical_use: Label for agency; not used in charts.

meaning: Main category of the problem reported.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Case variants (for example 'Plumbing' / 'PLUMBING') merged into the most common form: 192 rows changed, 172 raw values reduced to 170.
analytical_use: Top categories, median resolution, outliers, borough mix and the volume-vs-delay analysis (Tasks 2, 9, 11, 13, 15); dashboard filter.

meaning: More detailed description (sub-type) of the complaint type.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.
analytical_use: Shown in the record preview; not analysed.

meaning: Type of location where the problem was reported (for example residential building, sidewalk).
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.

meaning: ZIP code of the incident location.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Kept as text. Format check: values that are not 5 digits are flagged (0 flagged).

meaning: House number and street of the incident.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.

meaning: Street name of the incident location.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.

meaning: City name recorded for the incident (as entered; can include places outside NYC).
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Converted to UPPER CASE.

meaning: NYC borough of the incident; UNSPECIFIED when not provided.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Converted to UPPER CASE.
analytical_use: Borough volume, closure and top complaint types (Tasks 4, 13, 14); dashboard filter.

meaning: Recorded status of the request (Closed, In Progress, Open, Assigned, Pending, Started, Unspecified).
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.
analytical_use: Status distribution and the status/closed-date mismatch flag (Task 7).

example_value: The Police Department responded to the complaint and with the information available observed no evidence of the violation at that time.
meaning: Text of the last action recorded by the agency.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.

meaning: Date and time the agency last updated the resolution action.
transformation: Parsed to a date-time value (0 failed).
analytical_use: Only used for action_before_created_flag; otherwise unused.

meaning: Community board of the incident location.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.

meaning: Channel through which the request was submitted (for example PHONE, ONLINE).
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Converted to UPPER CASE.

meaning: Borough recorded in the park-borough field.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL. Converted to UPPER CASE.

meaning: Latitude of the incident (decimal degrees).
transformation: Converted to a number; missing values kept as NULL and flagged (coord_missing_flag).

meaning: Longitude of the incident (decimal degrees).
transformation: Converted to a number; missing values kept as NULL and flagged (coord_missing_flag).

meaning: Type of City facility linked to the request.
transformation: Whitespace trimmed and repeated spaces collapsed; empty text stored as NULL.

meaning: Date the agency is expected to update the request.
transformation: Parsed to a date-time value (0 failed).

meaning: TRUE when incident_zip is present but is not exactly 5 digits.
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only, rows kept (0 flagged).
analytical_use: Data-quality check; valid-ZIP filter in Task 13.

meaning: TRUE when latitude or longitude is missing.
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only (2,429 flagged).

meaning: TRUE when coordinates exist but fall outside a NYC bounding box (latitude 40.4 to 41.0, longitude -74.3 to -73.6).
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only (0 flagged).

meaning: 1 when a closed_date is recorded, otherwise 0.
transformation: Derived: closed_date is not blank.
analytical_use: Recorded closure and open requests (KPIs 2 and 3; Tasks 7 and 14). Not a measure of satisfaction.

meaning: TRUE when closed_date is earlier than created_date.
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only (27 flagged). resolution_hours is left blank for these rows.

meaning: TRUE when created_date or closed_date is later than the time the cleaning was run.
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only (0 flagged).

meaning: TRUE when a closed_date exists but status is not 'Closed'.
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only (482 flagged); rows kept (sensitivity test: median 7.66 h to 7.68 h).

meaning: Hours between created_date and closed_date.
transformation: Derived: (closed_date - created_date) in hours; left blank when closure is missing, closed before created, or in the future.
analytical_use: Descriptive statistics, medians, outliers, distribution and the 72-hour KPI (Tasks 8-12, 15).

meaning: Calendar date of created_date.
transformation: Derived: date part of created_date.

meaning: Year of created_date.
transformation: Derived from created_date.

meaning: Month number (1-12) of created_date.
transformation: Derived from created_date.

meaning: Year and month of created_date as YYYY-MM.
transformation: Derived from created_date.
analytical_use: Monthly trend and closure by month (Tasks 5 and 14).

meaning: Day-of-week name of created_date.
transformation: Derived from created_date.

meaning: Hour of day (0-23) of created_date.
transformation: Derived from created_date.

meaning: TRUE when resolution_action_updated_date is earlier than created_date.
transformation: Derived in cleaning; flag only (1,781 flagged); field otherwise unused.

meaning: TRUE when resolution_hours is above Q3 + 1.5 x IQR (upper fence 191.99 h; lower fence -113.33 h, so no low outliers).
transformation: Derived after cleaning from the valid durations (Q1 1.17 h, Q3 77.50 h, IQR 76.33 h); 17,869 flagged; blank durations are not flagged. Rows are kept.
analytical_use: Outlier investigation (Task 11). A prompt for investigation, not a deletion rule.
